spans.s: शव् vt. 1P (pres. शवति) 1. To go, to approach; 2. to transform, to alter, to change.
शव (I) m.n. A corpse, a dead body, M.iv.108.
शव (II) n. Water.
शाव (I) a. (f. वी) Relating to a dead body, e.g. दशाहं शावमाशौचम्.
शाव (II) m. The young of any animal, मृगशावैस्सह वर्धितो जनः Sak.ii., R.vi.3, xviii.37.
सव (I) m. 1. A sacrifice; 2. an offering; 3. the sun; 4. the moon.
सव (II) n. 1. Water; 2. the juice of flowers; 3. sprinkling the Soma.
साव m. A libation.
शव-आच्छादन n. covering of a corpse.
शव-आश a. eating carrion, feeding on corpses, Bt.xii.75.
शव-काम्य m. a dog.
शव-यान n. a hearse, litter for carrying a corpse.
शव-रथ m. a hearse, litter for carrying a corpse.
शवर m. 1. A barbarian, a savage; 2. an epithet of Śiva; 3. a hand; 4. water; 5. name of a learned writer on Mīmānsā.
शाव(ब)र (I) a. (f. री) 1. Barbarous; 2. low, vile.
शाव(ब)र (II) m. 1. Sin, wickedness; 2. fault, offence; 3. the Lodhra tree.
सवर m. 1. Water; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
सावर m. 1. Fault, offence; 2. sin, wickedness, crime; 3. the Lodhra tree.
शवर-आलय m. the abode of wild barbarous tribes.
शवर-लोध्र m. the white Lodhra tree.
शवल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Variegated, brindled; 2. divided into various parts.
शवल (II) m. A variegated colour.
शवल (III) n. Water.
शवल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Variegated, brindled; 2. divided into various parts.
शवला f. 1. A brindled cow; 2. a Kāmadhenu (q.v.).
शवला f. 1. A brindled cow; 2. a Kāmadhenu (q.v.).
शवसान (I) m. 1. A traveller; 2. a road.
शवसान (II) n. A cemetery.
शाव (I) a. (f. वी) Relating to a dead body, e.g. दशाहं शावमाशौचम्.
शावक m. The young of any animal.
सावक (I) a. (f. विका) Generative, productive, parturient.
सावक (II) m. The young (of any animal); (in this sense for शावक).
शाव(ब)र (I) a. (f. री) 1. Barbarous; 2. low, vile.
शाव(ब)री f. A low Prākṛt dialect.
शाव(ब)र-भेदाक्ष n. copper.
सवन (I) m. The moon.
सवन (II) n. 1. Extracting and drinking the Soma juice; 2. a sacrifice, सायंतने सवनकर्मणि संप्रवृत्ते Sak.iii.; 3. the act of bearing children, generation; 4. ablution.
सावन (I) a. (f. नी) Relating to, or comprising the three savanas.

सावन (II) m. 1. An institutor of a sacrifice; 2. the conclusion of a sacrifice or the ceremony by which it is terminated; 3. an epithet of Varuṇa; 4. a month of thirty solar days; 5. natural day from sunrise to sunset.
सवयस् (I) a. Of the same age.
सवयस् (II) m. A coeval, a contemporary.
सवयस् (III) f. A womans confidante.

सवर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Being of the same colour or appear ance, like, resembling, त्वय्यारूढं शिखरमचलस्निग्धवेणीसवर्णे Megh.i.18, R.ix.51; 2. of the same tribe or class; 3. of the same kind, homogeneous; 4. belonging to the same class of letters, i.e. requiring the same effort in pronunciation.

सावर्ण (I) a. (f. र्णी) Relating to one of the same colour, tribe or caste.
सावर्ण (II) m. A metronymic of the eighth Manu.
सविकल्प a. (f. ल्पा) Recognizing distinctions (namely those of subject and object) (as op. to निर्विकल्प) (in Vedānta phil.).

सवितर्कम् ind. With reasoning, thoughtfully.
सवितृ (I) a. (f. त्री) Producer, giver, सवित्री कामानां यदि जगति जागर्ति भवती G.
सवितृ (II) m. 1. The sun, येषां कुलेषु सविता च गुरुर्वयं च Ut.i.; 2. an epithet of Indra; 3. of Śiva.
सवितृ (I) a. (f. त्री) Producer, giver, सवित्री कामानां यदि जगति जागर्ति भवती G.
सवित्री f. 1. A mother; 2. a cow.
सावित्र (I) a. (f. त्री) 1. Descended from the sun, belonging to the Solar dynasty, यत्सावित्रैर्दीपितं भूमिपालैः Ut.i.; 2. accompanied by the Gāyatrī.

सावित्री f. 1. A ray of light; 2. name of a celebrated verse of the Ṛgveda (iii.62.8) addressed to the sun, the same as गायत्री q.v.; 3. name of a wife of Brahman (m.); 4. the thread ceremony; 5. an epithet of Pārvatī; 6. of a wife of Kaśyapa; 7. of the wife of Satyavat, king Sālva. (See App. II.)
सविध (I) a. (f. धा) 1. Of the same kind or sort; 2. near, proximate, भूयो भूयः सविधनगरीरथ्यया पर्यटंतम् M.M.i.
सविध (II) n. Proximity, vicinity, किमासेद्यं पुंसां सविधमनवद्यं द्युसरितः K.Pr.x.
सविध (I) a. (f. धा) 1. Of the same kind or sort; 2. near, proximate, भूयो भूयः सविधनगरीरथ्यया पर्यटंतम् M.M.i.
सविमर्शम् ind. Thoughtfully.

सविशेष a. (f. षा) 1. possessing characteristic qualities; 2. peculiar, extraordinary; 3. excellent, superior; 4. descriminative.(सविशेषम् or सविशेषतस् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘in a peculiar manner, especially, singularly,’ अनेन धर्मः सविशेषमद्यु मे त्रिवर्गसारः प्रतिभाति भामिनि K.S.v.38.)

सव्य-साचिन् m. an epithet of Arjuna, निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन् Bg.xi.33.
सव्यपेक्ष a. (f. क्षा) Having connection, connected, dependent on, स्नेहश्च निमित्तसव्यपेक्षश्चेति विप्रतिषिद्धमेतत् M.M.i.
